name: Dental Implants
summary: Titanium or ceramic implants placed by certified oral surgeons, restoring both function and confidence with results built to last decades.
duration: Typically 1–2 visits over 3–6 months (same-day assessment available)
includes: 3D CBCT scan and digital treatment planning
Local anaesthesia and post-op care kit

faq.q: How long does an implant take?
faq.a: The implant fixture is placed in one visit; the crown is fitted after 3–6 months of healing. Many patients split this across two trips.
It is performed under local anaesthesia. Most patients report only mild discomfort, managed with standard pain relief.

faq.q: What brands of implants are used?
faq.a: Partner clinics use internationally recognised systems (e.g. Nobel Biocare, Straumann, Osstem) — specified in your treatment plan.
